newsitem.title: USA: Coleman to take $7.5 mln in charges.
newsitem.headline: Coleman to take $7.5 mln in charges.

text.p: Coleman Co Inc said Thursday it would take about $7.5 million in charges in future quarters in light of the cost to restructure and rationalize its operations.
Coleman said in a statement that the cost totaled about $30 million on a pre-tax basis, $3.9 million of which was recorded in the first quarter and another $18.6 million in the second.
An official at the company said the remaining $7.5 million would be recorded in the balance of the year.

Coleman reported a profit of $0.19 per share for the second quarter against $0.52 a year ago. The current year's earnings were lower due to a charge of $0.22 per share related to the restructuring. It said it included a program to reduce wholesaler inventory in Japan when it calculated the cost.

"We have now identified and are putting in place over $50 million of annualized cost savings against the 1997 plan from reductions in personnel, production facilities and administrative overhead combined with improved productivity and working capital management," it said.
